Eiffel Tower visit: BAPS denies asking for female staff removal

An investigation into a controversy surrounding a visit by the Bochasanwasi Akshar Purushottam Swaminarayan Sanstha (BAPS) delegation to the Eiffel Tower on September 5 has concluded that BAPS made no explicit request to exclude female staff. While women were ultimately removed or replaced at some posts, the probe attributed this to a "chain of errors" in handling a request to avoid physical contact with women. BAPS has consistently stated it never asked for female employees to be hidden, removed, or excluded, and claims the message was distorted internally.
